title: grafana-schema: never hand-edit generated files; CUE edits must keep veneer and dual composable copies in sync
answers: Can I edit panelcfg.gen.ts or common.gen.ts directly?
What breaks if I add @grafana(TSVeneer="type") without a veneer file?
Why does editing panelcfg.cue change two generated files?
body:
Files with the 'Code generated - EDITING IS FUTILE' header (e.g. `src/common/common.gen.ts`, `src/raw/**/types.gen.ts`, `*_gen.cue`) must never be hand-patched; edit the source `.cue` and run `make gen-cue`.
- CUE field tagged `@grafana(TSVeneer="type")` (e.g. `kinds/dashboard/dashboard_kind.cue`) causes `TSVeneerIndexJenny` (`pkg/codegen/jenny_tsveneerindex.go`) to OMIT that symbol from the raw re-export in `index.gen.ts` and instead expect a hand-written definition in `packages/grafana-schema/src/veneer/*.ts` (e.g. `dashboard.types.ts`). Adding/removing this attribute without adding/removing the matching veneer symbol breaks the TS build.
- Editing a built-in panel's `panelcfg.cue` (or `dataquery.cue`) regenerates TWO copies from one source via `public/app/plugins/gen.go`: the plugin-local `panelcfg.gen.ts` in `public/app/plugins/panel/<name>/` and the mirror at `packages/grafana-schema/src/raw/composable/<name>/panelcfg/x/types.gen.ts`. Patching only one leaves them inconsistent; always regenerate both via `make gen-cue`.
- Adding a new composable-kind or app-SDK output path requires adding the matching subpath to `packages/grafana-schema/package.json`'s `exports` map — the build doesn't auto-discover new output paths.
applies: Applies to any change touching packages/grafana-schema/src/common/*.cue, kinds/*.cue, or a plugin's panelcfg.cue/dataquery.cue; does not apply to hand-written files under src/veneer/ or src/schema/ which are legitimately editable.
says: Generated file keeps reverting when I edit it directly

Schema source changes not appearing in generated output
